essentialTracks.title: The Way You Used to Do

shortBio.en: Homme-led hard rock/alt; riff machine behind Them Crooked Vultures link.
shortBio.zh: Homme 领衔的 hard rock/alt；通向 Them Crooked Vultures 的 riff 机器。

body.en:
Formed 1996 in California after Kyuss ends. Early records and Songs for the Deaf (2002, with Dave Grohl on drums) fix Homme's tuned-down, repetitive riff writing, Nick Oliveri's bass era, and Mark Lanegan guest vocals.

Bridge node: QOTSA method → Them Crooked Vultures with Grohl and John Paul Jones. Emphasis is groove lock and dry desert production, not shred display.
body.zh:
1996 年于加州 Kyuss 结束后组建。早期唱片与 Songs for the Deaf（2002，Dave Grohl 鼓）定型 Homme 降调反复 riff、Nick Oliveri 贝斯时期与 Mark Lanegan 客串人声。

桥接节点：QOTSA 方法 → 与 Grohl、John Paul Jones 的 Them Crooked Vultures。重点是 groove 锁定与干燥沙漠制作，而非速弹展示。

whyMatters.en: Josh Homme's desert-rock project after Kyuss; Queens of the Stone Age (1998) onward built hypnotic, down-tuned riffs that feed later Homme collaborations.
whyMatters.zh: Josh Homme 在 Kyuss 之后沙漠摇滚项目；自同名专辑（1998）起建立催眠、降调 riff，并喂养后期 Homme 合作。

note.en: Grohl on drums—stop-start riff and desert-dry mix on Songs for the Deaf.
note.zh: Grohl 打鼓——Songs for the Deaf 上停走 riff 与沙漠干混音。

note.en: Melodic chorus over repetitive verse riff—Homme's pop instinct inside stoner rock.
note.zh: 重复主歌 riff 上旋律副歌——stoner rock 内的 Homme pop 本能。

note.en: Bo Diddley beat in a 2:40 hard-rock single—Lullabies to Paralyze groove shift.
note.zh: Bo Diddley 节拍装进 2:40 hard-rock 单曲——Lullabies to Paralyze groove 转向。

body.en:
Homme forms Gamma Ray, renamed Queens of the Stone Age after legal conflict. Debut QOTSA (1998) and Rated R (2000) use C tuning, repetitive riffs, and sparse vocal delivery.

Nick Oliveri joins on bass—high harmonies and aggression balance Homme's low register.

Mark Lanegan guests on vocals; desert rock defined as groove hypnosis, not jam sprawl.
body.zh:
Homme 组建 Gamma Ray，法律冲突后改名 Queens of the Stone Age。首张 QOTSA（1998）与 Rated R（2000）用 C 调、重复 riff 与稀疏人声。

Nick Oliveri 加入贝斯——高音和声与侵略性平衡 Homme 低区。

Mark Lanegan 客串人声；沙漠摇滚定义为 groove 催眠，非 jam 膨胀。

title.en: Songs for the Deaf: Grohl on drums
title.zh: Songs for the Deaf：Grohl 打鼓

body.en:
Homme produces and Grohl drums on Songs for the Deaf (2002)—No One Knows and Go with the Flow hit US rock radio.

Mix is dry and mid-forward; riffs repeat with micro-variation, not solo breaks.

Album title references desert highway radio static—concept as production note, not myth.
body.zh:
Homme 制作、Grohl 打鼓于 Songs for the Deaf（2002）——No One Knows 与 Go with the Flow 打美国 rock 电台。

混音干、中频前置；riff 反复带微变化，非 solo 段。

专辑名指沙漠公路电台静电——概念即制作笔记，非神话。

body.en:
Lullabies to Paralyze (2005) and Era Vulgaris (2007) rotate lineups; Troy Van Leeuwen adds second-guitar texture.

Homme's producer credits and Grohl drum guest spot create the personnel web for Them Crooked Vultures (2009).

QOTSA remains Homme's primary vehicle—riff discipline and desert production as constant.
body.zh:
Lullabies to Paralyze（2005）与 Era Vulgaris（2007）轮换阵容；Troy Van Leeuwen 加第二吉他纹理。

Homme 制作人 credit 与 Grohl 鼓客座织出 Them Crooked Vultures（2009）人事网。

QOTSA 仍是 Homme 主载体——riff 纪律与沙漠制作为常量。
